combine_definition: forty-yard dash: (4 − 2) / time between the first recorded crossings of 2 and 4 yd/s
nfl_definition: accelerating episode: the same quantity between the first crossings INSIDE the episode
smoothing: Savitzky–Golay (NFL: window 7 frames, order 2; Combine: sequence frames of notebook 01)
window_rule: movement_demands.band_accel on both sides; null unless both crossings are recorded
caveat: the forty is one maximal-effort transit from rest; an NFL episode is a context-driven, usually submaximal effort

combine_definition: 95th percentile of tracked speed in the forty (atlas F2.forty.p95_speed)
nfl_definition: largest speed of a sustained high-speed episode
smoothing: Savitzky–Golay (NFL: window 7 frames, order 2; Combine: sequence frames of notebook 01)
window_rule: a percentile of a 40-yard run against the peak of an episode: both are largest-speed summaries, not the same statistic
caveat: 40 yards may end before an athlete's top speed; game speed is not a maximum

combine_definition: not measured by the forty-yard dash
nfl_definition: |tangential acceleration| < 1 yd/s² at ≥ 5 yd/s for ≥ 1 s
smoothing: Savitzky–Golay (NFL: window 7 frames, order 2; Combine: sequence frames of notebook 01)
caveat: none: forty recordings usually end at or before the speed peak (last-frame censoring)

combine_definition: not measured by the forty-yard dash
nfl_definition: a run with tangential acceleration ≤ −1 yd/s² for ≥ 0.4 s from ≥ 4 yd/s with a speed drop ≥ 2 yd/s
smoothing: Savitzky–Golay (NFL: window 7 frames, order 2; Combine: sequence frames of notebook 01)
caveat: none: the forty contains no braking phase inside the timed run

combine_definition: not measured by the forty-yard dash
nfl_definition: a run of frames with tangential acceleration ≥ 1 yd/s² lasting ≥ 0.5 s with a speed gain ≥ 1.5 yd/s, starting within 1 s after a braking episode
smoothing: Savitzky–Golay (NFL: window 7 frames, order 2; Combine: sequence frames of notebook 01)
caveat: none: the forty contains no braking, so no re-acceleration

combine_definition: not measured by the forty-yard dash
nfl_definition: |heading change| ≥ 45° at |yaw rate| ≥ 60 deg/s and speed ≥ 3 yd/s, every frame with a valid heading
smoothing: Savitzky–Golay (NFL: window 7 frames, order 2; Combine: sequence frames of notebook 01)
caveat: none: the forty is a straight run

combine_definition: not measured by the forty-yard dash
nfl_definition: a player-play with ≥ 2 accelerating episodes and ≥ 1 braking episode
